aug.nanoaug.social.1.desc: Shows the villager's profession and mood on the HUD and gives 15% off trades.
aug.nanoaug.social.2.desc: 35% off, shows the exact price and villagers and golems stop distrusting your prosthetics.
aug.nanoaug.smart_vision.1.desc: Night vision and highlights visible nearby enemies (16 blocks). Your eyes glow amber. High energy use.
aug.nanoaug.magpie.1.desc: With Smart Vision on, highlights items on the ground (16 blocks).
aug.nanoaug.wayfinder.1.desc: While Smart Vision is on, shows a HUD radar with creatures within 20 blocks.
aug.nanoaug.wayfinder.3.desc: The radar shows where each creature is facing.
aug.nanoaug.sentinel.1.desc: Regenerates 0.5 HP per second after a few seconds without damage.
aug.nanoaug.regen_delay.1.desc: Shorter delay before regeneration starts (3 s).
aug.nanoaug.sarif_delay.1.desc: Shorter delay to recharge after depletion (3 s).
aug.nanoaug.rebreather.1.desc: Breathe underwater while energy lasts (low use).
aug.nanoaug.arm.1.desc: +2 damage, mine 50% faster and unlocks arm upgrades. Visible prosthetics: villagers distrust you (+15% prices) and iron golems turn hostile. Cloak or Dialectic Enhancer prevent it.
aug.nanoaug.punch.1.desc: Passive: with an empty hand, hold attack and fragile walls (stone, brick, wood) burst instantly in a 3x3 area. Uses a little energy.
aug.nanoaug.punch.2.desc: Also breaks deepslate and ores, in a 5x5 area.
aug.nanoaug.takedown.1.desc: Passive: with an empty hand, one hit on any unaware creature (mobs, villagers, players), or while sneaking/cloaked, takes it down instantly (20 energy). Against an alert target it is just a strong punch.
aug.nanoaug.reload.1.desc: Bows, crossbows and tridents charge 50% faster.
aug.nanoaug.reload.2.desc: Bows, crossbows and tridents charge 100% faster.
aug.nanoaug.peps.1.desc: Concussive cone blast that knocks enemies back.
aug.nanoaug.peps.2.desc: While sneaking: narrow beam that knocks the target unconscious (slowed and blinded).
aug.nanoaug.remote_hack.1.desc: Passive: right-click with an empty hand on levers, buttons, doors, trapdoors and gates up to 10 blocks away. Uses 5 energy.
aug.nanoaug.remote_hack.2.desc: 20 block range and also toggles redstone lamps.
aug.nanoaug.remote_hack.3.desc: Also triggers dispensers and droppers, disables sculk sensors for 20 s and stops shriekers from summoning the Warden.
aug.nanoaug.tesla.1.desc: Yellow electric arc that stuns 1 target (range 8). Uses 1 TESLA Cartridge (free during Overclock).
aug.nanoaug.nanoblade.1.desc: Fires the blade as a fast projectile. Uses 1 Nanoblade Ammo (free during Overclock).
aug.nanoaug.icarus_landing.1.desc: Negates fall damage from any height.
aug.nanoaug.icarus_landing.2.desc: Long falls trigger Icarus Strike: a shockwave that hurts and stuns.
aug.nanoaug.typhoon.1.desc: 360-degree burst. Choose a configuration below. Uses 1 Typhoon Ammo (free during Overclock).
aug.nanoaug.typhoon_lethal.1.desc: Fires 16 lethal projectiles in a ring. Exclusive with Stun.
aug.nanoaug.typhoon_stun.1.desc: Burst that stuns enemies within 8 blocks. Exclusive with Lethal.
aug.nanoaug.icarus_dash.1.desc: Tap: quick forward dash. Hold: a yellow box shows your destination. Aim up, down or sideways and release to go there (aiming at a wall just below a ledge climbs it).
aug.nanoaug.icarus_dash.2.desc: Longer range (14 blocks) and less energy per dash.
aug.nanoaug.icarus_dash.3.desc: The dash rams and hurts enemies in your path.
aug.nanoaug.cloak.1.desc: Invisibility. Moving drains much more energy. Attacking breaks it.
aug.nanoaug.cloak_takedown.1.desc: Attacking no longer breaks the cloak.
aug.nanoaug.titan.1.desc: Negates all damage while on. Moving drains much more energy.
aug.nanoaug.leg.1.desc: +12% speed and step up blocks without jumping. Visible prosthetics: villagers distrust you (+15% prices) and golems turn hostile. Cloak or Dialectic Enhancer prevent it.
aug.nanoaug.klipspringer.1.desc: Jump much higher and survive 4 extra blocks of falling.
